company.name: Varonis Systems, Inc.
company.shortDescription: Varonis secures AI and the data that powers it.
company.description: Varonis is a data and AI security platform that automatically discovers sensitive data, reduces exposure, and stops human and non-human threats, helping enterprises safely deploy AI by securing the data that powers it.

productsAndServices.description: A SaaS-based platform for discovering and classifying sensitive data, analyzing access, remediating exposure, monitoring activity, and detecting data-centric threats across cloud, SaaS, hybrid, and on-premises environments.
productsAndServices.name: Varonis Data Security Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI security platform that monitors and protects AI applications, agents, models, data, and interactions across the AI data lifecycle, including enterprise AI platforms and development environments.
productsAndServices.name: Varonis Atlas

productsAndServices.description: An AI-native email and browser security solution that detects phishing and social engineering attacks, blocks malicious websites and credential theft, and applies controls to prevent email-based data leaks.
productsAndServices.name: Varonis Interceptor

productsAndServices.description: An agentless database activity monitoring product that monitors activity across cloud, on-premises, managed, and unmanaged databases to help detect threats and protect sensitive database data.
productsAndServices.name: Varonis Next-Gen DAM

productsAndServices.description: A managed security service that provides continuous monitoring, threat hunting, alert investigation, and incident response for customer data environments around the clock.
productsAndServices.name: Managed Data Detection & Response (MDDR)

productsAndServices.description: A professional services offering that provides expert guidance and hands-on assistance with deploying, configuring, operating, and improving Varonis data security capabilities.
productsAndServices.name: Varonis Concierge

aiResearchSummary.text: Varonis Systems is researching automated permissions management, as described in 'Method and system for automated permissions management' and 'Automatic management of user permissions,' which detail grouping users and generating cluster-based permissions. Their work on 'Network security probe' focuses on monitoring security controls via configurable probe engines. Additional efforts include 'Optimized file classification with supervised learning' and 'Systems and methods for data monitoring,' addressing file classification and data element monitoring.
